charts.title: TOI-7393 b: orbits around TOI-7393
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-7393's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-7393 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Premnath et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172...92P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PREMNATH_ET_AL_2026): P 3.33708 d

charts.title: TOI-7393 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-7393 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (76, 77) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 165598669, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
